title: RSF Captures Ambro and Furuawiya, North Darfur, in Chad-Border Offensive
detail: RSF field commanders announced the capture of Ambro town on June 23 and, the following day, Furuawiya village east of Ambro, as part of a renewed offensive along the Chadian border in North Darfur. A tribal leader reported RSF fighters looting and burning homes before advancing. IOM reported more than 2,200 people displaced from the Orshi Reservoir area and neighboring villages in the preceding week as the RSF push accelerated.

title: 215+ Detainees Reported Dead at RSF-Run Daqrees Prison, Nyala
detail: Sudan Doctors Network reported on June 24, 2026 that more than 215 civilian detainees died during May-June 2026 at Daqrees (Dagris) Prison in RSF-held Nyala, South Darfur, from disease, torture, and denial of medical care under conditions described as 'lacking even the most basic standards of healthcare and human dignity.' Thirty-one detainees, including children, had been transferred to Nyala Hospital more than two weeks earlier with their current status/whereabouts unknown. Medical personnel also alleged RSF was extracting blood from prisoners for wounded fighters. Sudanese authorities estimate RSF holds 19,000+ military and civilian detainees across Darfur. A fuller documentation of the same 215+ deaths was published by the Committee for Justice on July 8, 2026.
